Job Location MUMBAI GENERAL OFFICE
 Job Description 
 This is a 6-month internship program. During this period, you may be aligned to one of the roles outlined below, based on business requirements, your skills, and overall fit. We encourage you to go through each role to understand the scope of work and expectations. 
 Information Technology Intern (Software Engineering) 
 Overview 
At Procter & Gamble, IT is at the core of how we innovate, make decisions, and deliver impact at scale. As a Software Engineering Intern, you will help design, build, and ship applications on our Data & Analytics Platform, learning modern Agile and DevOps practices while contributing to real, global projects. 
You will work alongside experienced full-stack engineers to develop cloud-native solutions, gaining hands-on exposure to the full software development lifecycle. 
 What You’ll Do 
Contribute to writing and testing code for Data & Analytics applications 
Support building end-to-end cloud-native (Azure) solutions 
Learn and apply modern software engineering practices ( CI/CD, Agile, DevOps ) 
Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product teams to deliver features 
Help translate designs into clear, detailed low-level documentation 
 What We’re Looking For 
Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience 
Foundational programming skills in Java and/or TypeScript 
Understanding of relational databases and basic SQL 
Strong problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills 
A desire to produce high-quality software through testing, code reviews, and teamwork 
 Preferred Skills (not mandatory) 
Exposure to Spring Framework and/or React 
Familiarity with Azure Cloud services, Python, or Angular 
Understanding of version control (Git) and CI/CD concepts 
Experience contributing to team projects or technical documentation 
 What You’ll Gain 
Hands-on experience building real applications from Day 1 
Mentorship from experienced full-stack engineers 
Exposure to modern cloud and DevOps toolchains 
A chance to work in multinational, cross-functional teams 
 Why Join Us 
We produce globally recognized brands and build leaders across functions. You'll work in an environment that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning - with the opportunity to make a real impact early in your career. 
 Information Technology Intern (Platform Engineering) 
 Overview 
At Procter & Gamble, IT is at the core of how we innovate, make decisions, and deliver impact at scale. As a Platform Engineering Intern, you will help build, maintain, and optimize our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and overall DevOps practices. 
You will learn Infrastructure as Code and containerization while supporting the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our applications and services on high-impact global projects. 
 What You’ll Do 
Support designing and managing scalable, secure cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) 
Help build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for automated delivery and testing 
Learn containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes 
Assist with monitoring, logging, and alerting to keep platforms reliable 
Collaborate with development teams to embed DevOps practices across the lifecycle 
 What We’re Looking For 
Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 
Foundational understanding of cloud platforms (Azure preferred) 
Basic scripting skills in Python and/or Bash 
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail 
Good communication and collaboration skills 
 Preferred Skills (not mandatory) 
Exposure to Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools 
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes 
Understanding of CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI) 
Awareness of monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Azure Monitor) 
Interest in Agile methodologies 
 What You’ll Gain 
Hands-on experience with modern cloud and DevOps tooling 
Mentorship from experienced platform and DevOps engineers 
Exposure to Infrastructure as Code and container orchestration 
A chance to deliver high-impact, global platform projects 
 Why Join Us 
We produce globally recognized brands and build leaders across functions. You'll work in an environment that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning - with the opportunity to make a real impact early in your career. 
 Information Technology Intern (AI Engineering) 
 Overview 
At Procter & Gamble, IT is at the core of how we innovate, make decisions, and deliver impact at scale. As an AI Engineering Intern, you will help ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of our production AI/ML systems. 
Blending software engineering principles with operations, you will support building scalable, observable solutions on Azure while collaborating with development and operations teams on automation and optimization. 
 What You’ll Do 
Support maintaining production systems for high availability and reliability 
Help build monitoring and observability dashboards and alerts for system health 
Contribute to automation solutions for routine operational tasks 
Assist in developing and maintaining automated tests for production systems 
Support production deployments and change management for minimal downtime 
 What We’re Looking For 
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field 
Understanding of cloud computing concepts, particularly Microsoft Azure 
Intermediate Python programming skills 
Strong problem-solving skills 
Strong written and verbal communication in English 
 Preferred Skills (not mandatory) 
Exposure to AI/ML products such as Azure Machine Learning and Databricks 
Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and logging implementation 
Experience with source control (GitHub), pull request reviews, and static analysis (e.g., SonarQube) 
Interest in writing tests with Pytest 
 What You’ll Gain 
Hands-on experience with production AI/ML systems from Day 1 
Mentorship from experienced SRE and AI engineers 
Exposure to modern MLOps, monitoring, and automation tools 
A chance to work at the intersection of AI, reliability, and engineering 
 Why Join Us 
We produce globally recognized brands and build leaders across functions. You'll work in an environment that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning - with the opportunity to make a real impact early in your career. 
 Information Technology Intern (Data Science / Data Engineering) 
 Overview 
At Procter & Gamble, IT is at the core of how we innovate, make decisions, and deliver impact at scale. As an Intern, you will work on real business problems using data — whether that involves building scalable data pipelines or developing advanced analytical and machine learning models. 
Depending on business needs and your strengths, you may work in either a Data Engineering or Data Science capacity — both roles collaborate closely to deliver end-to-end data solutions. 
 What You’ll Do 
Work on real-world business problems using large and complex datasets 
Build, analyze, and derive insights from data to support decision-making 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business, product, and engineering 
Contribute to the design and development of scalable data or analytics solutions 
 If aligned to Data Engineering, you will: 
Develop and maintain data pipelines and workflows 
Work with structured and unstructured data at scale 
Support data platform development and data quality initiatives 
 If aligned to Data Science, you will: 
Apply statistical analysis and machine learning techniques 
Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering 
Build and evaluate predictive or optimization models 
 What You’ll Gain 
Hands-on experience working on live business problems from Day 1 
Exposure to modern data platforms and tools 
Mentorship and learning opportunities from experienced professionals 
A chance to work at the intersection of business, data, and technology 
 Job Qualifications 
 What We’re Looking For 
Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field 
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills 
Proficiency in Python and/or SQL 
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and basic statistics 
 Preferred Skills (not mandatory) 
Exposure to machine learning , data analysis, or big data concepts 
Familiarity with tools/frameworks such as Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Spark , or similar 
Experience working with large datasets or cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, etc.) 
Basic understanding of software engineering practices (Git, testing, CI/CD) 
 Job Schedule Full time
 Job Number R000161858
 Job Segmentation Internships

 Job Description 
Procter & Gamble is dedicated to providing valuable hands-on experience to interns and co-op students. This non-management role is an excellent opportunity for growth and learning within the company. 
Job Description 
This Intern/Co-op role is designed to provide students with a well-rounded work experience. Interns will have the opportunity to work on a variety of tasks, gain practical skills, and contribute to team projects. 
Key Responsibilities 
Participate in team projects and contribute to achieving team goals. 
Perform tasks as assigned, ensuring quality and timeliness. 
Learn and apply new concepts, tools, and techniques as part of the internship/co-op experience. 
Cultivate strong collaborative relationships within the team. 
Engage in learning opportunities for personal growth and development. 
Qualifications 
Current enrollment in a relevant degree program. 
Eagerness to learn and grow professionally. 
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. 
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. 
 Job Qualifications 
MBA 
 Job Schedule Full time
